goal: Validate numeric command-line and config options to reject negative, zero, or out-of-range values at startup
Prevent silent integer wrapping or crashes that cause stuck IBD, unbounded batches, or wrong fees
agreement: Approach objection: validate arguments centrally in the argument parser rather than piecemeal (sedited)
Objected to manual call-site parsing, chrono type mismatches, and removing saturation (maflcko)
Objected to a backwards code comment on mempool expiry alongside test and doc fixes (l0rinc, ryanofsky)
Support because it cleanly fails at startup on nonsensical configuration values (fjahr, ryanofsky)

why: P3 because prevents nodes from crashing or running with corrupt limits when given out-of-range arguments
Replaces silent overflow and bad state transitions with clear startup errors for node operators
